item.title: New Scalpay Car Park Created to Support Growing Numbers of Island Walkers
item.description: A new public car park has opened on the island of Scalpay after Bakkafrost Scotland supported community efforts to manage rising visitor numbers along the popular Scalpay Heritage Trail.The post New Scalpay Car Park Created to Support Growing Numbers of Island Walkers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Whisky Duty Rise Linked To £156m Revenue Fall
item.description: Scotland’s whisky industry has become the centre of a political row after new figures revealed a £156 million fall in alcohol duty revenue following a Treasury tax rise, raising questions about the impact on producers and public finances.The post Labour Whisky Duty Rise Linked To £156m Revenue Fall appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Naver Bridge Opens to Traffic on North Coast Route
item.description: A new bridge over the River Naver near Bettyhill has opened to traffic on the A836 in Sutherland, marking a major step in improving one of the key routes along the North Coast 500.The post New Naver Bridge Opens to Traffic on North Coast Route appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Women are Being Failed by Endometriosis Care
item.description: An Inverness nurse who has been hospitalised dozens of times with endometriosis has launched a new support group to help women across the Highlands find community, share experiences and campaign for better diagnosis and care.The post Women are Being Failed by Endometriosis Care appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Easter Ferry Suspension Sparks Anger on Mallaig and Skye Route
item.description: Ferry services between Mallaig and Armadale will be suspended for more than two weeks over Easter, raising concern among west coast communities and businesses that rely on the historic crossing between the mainland and Skye.The post Easter Ferry Suspension Sparks Anger on Mallaig and Skye Route appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Wildfire Action Plan Aims To Strengthen Protection Across The Highlands
item.description: A new Scottish Government action plan aimed at improving wildfire prevention and response has been welcomed by a Highlands MSP, as concerns grow over the risks fires pose to peatlands, landscapes and rural communities.The post New Wildfire Action Plan Aims To Strengthen Protection Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Drugs Worth £180,000 Seized in Major Operation Targeting Immigration Crime
item.description: Drugs worth more than £180,000 have been seized during a major multi agency operation targeting organised immigration crime at airports, ferry ports and transport routes across Scotland.The post Drugs Worth £180,000 Seized in Major Operation Targeting Immigration Crime appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Labour Candidate Says He Would Vote Against Assisted Dying Bill
item.description: Scottish Labour and Scottish Co operative Party candidate for Orkney Mike Macleod has said he would vote against Scotland’s proposed Assisted Dying Bill if elected to the Scottish Parliament. Mr Macleod made his position clear while discussing the Assisted Dying for Terminally Ill Adults Scotland Bill brought forward by Orkney MSP Liam McArthur. item.title: ALBA Continuation Group Offers Indemnity To Ease Leadership Transition
item.description: The ALBA Continuation Group has offered an unconditional indemnity to leader Kenny MacAskill as part of a proposal aimed at resolving internal tensions and preparing the pro independence party for the next Scottish Parliament election.The post ALBA Continuation Group Offers Indemnity To Ease Leadership Transition appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Dramatic Coastal Home Above Rosemarkie Beach
item.description: Camas Glas in Rosemarkie is a five bedroom coastal home overlooking the Moray Firth, offering open plan living across four levels, wraparound balcony, generous gardens and entertaining terrace above Rosemarkie Beach.The post A Dramatic Coastal Home Above Rosemarkie Beach appeared first on The Highland Times.
